You ran a command that reads or writes events: tools macos calendar (list, search, add, update, delete) or tools todo sync. Nothing is read outside those commands.
You ran a command that reads or writes reminders: tools macos reminders, tools todo, or the dev-dashboard todo sync. Nothing is read outside those commands.
You ran a command that reads or writes events: tools macos calendar (list, search, add, update, delete) or tools todo sync. Nothing is read outside those commands.
You ran tools macos calendar add, which creates an event. Full Access is only needed to list or search events.
You ran a command that reads or writes reminders: tools macos reminders, tools todo, or the dev-dashboard todo sync. Nothing is read outside those commands.
You ran tools macos mail or messages, which resolve sender and attendee names from your contacts. Contacts are only read, never changed.
You ran tools transcribe or tools macos voice-memos transcribe, which turn an audio file into text with Apple's on-device speech engine. Audio stays on this Mac.
You ran tools ask with voice dictation, which records from the microphone while you speak. Nothing records outside that command.
You ran a command that drives another app through AppleScript: tools say, tools macos control, or the Mail and Calendar helpers. GenesisTools only sends the events that command needs.

You passed a Desktop path to a tools command (a HAR file for har-analyzer, an export, a screenshot). GenesisTools reads only the file you named. Allowing this folder is enough; Full Disk Access is only needed for Mail, Messages and Voice Memos.
You passed a Documents path to a tools command. GenesisTools reads only the file you named. Allowing this folder is enough; Full Disk Access is only needed for Mail, Messages and Voice Memos.

You passed a Downloads path to a tools command, usually a HAR file for tools har-analyzer. GenesisTools reads only the file you named. Allowing this folder is enough; Full Disk Access is only needed for Mail, Messages and Voice Memos.
You passed a path on an external drive to a tools command. GenesisTools reads only the file you named.
You passed a path on a network volume to a tools command. GenesisTools reads only the file you named.
Full Disk Access lets tools macos mail, messages and voice-memos read the Mail, Messages and Voice Memos databases. Nothing else in GenesisTools needs it.
